name: Write File
description: Write a file under a configured filesystem root or to an authorised DLFS path. Creates the file if absent and overwrites it otherwise. Parent directories must exist. Supply exactly one of content, value, bytes, or asset.
creator: Covia

root.description: Configured root name; omit for a canonical DLFS path

path.description: Path relative to root, dlfs/<drive>/<path>, or <ownerDID>/dlfs/<drive>/<path>

value.description: JSON-serialisable value to write as UTF-8 JSON

asset.description: Asset reference to stream as file content (e.g. '/a/0x1234...', DID URL)

created.description: True if the file was newly created
